content.introduction: According to Investtech, the S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term, indicating good market development. However, the index has broken a double top formation and a decisive break of the support at 7552 will signal a fall to 7300 or less. The index has support at 6930 and resistance at 7800. The RSI curve shows a falling trend, which is an early signal of a possible trend reversal downwards. The medium term recommendation is to hold the index with a score of -0. The volatility over 66 days is 10.11%.
body:
S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term. This shows that investors over time have bought the index at higher prices and indicates good development for the market. However, the index has broken a double top formation. A decisive break of the support at 7552 will signal a fall to 7300 or less. The index has support at points 6930 and resistance at points 7800.
